_comment: US-858. Serious+critical axe node counts per authenticated route, re-measured 2026-09-11 against a household that actually resolves and a pantry with food in it. The previous numbers were taken against degraded screens: get_user_household_id answered [] from the fake backend (US-857), so the dashboard read 3 and the pantry read 46 -- and that 46 was AppContext's STARTER SEED, which it plants only when nothing loads at all, so it described neither an empty pantry nor a real one. These numbers may only go DOWN: the assertion is <=, so a fix tightens the gate automatically. Regenerate deliberately with A11Y_BASELINE=update --workers=1, never to turn a red run green.
_measurementNote: Every one of the 12 remaining nodes is white text on one of two colours: #16a249 (hsl 142 76% 36%, which is --secondary and --safe-food, the same colour defined twice) at 3.33:1, and #f97015 (hsl 24 95% 53%, --try-bite) at 2.85:1. Both are recorded as ratchets in src/lib/themeContrast.test.ts with the lightness each needs to clear AA. Fixing either token drops several routes at once; see US-858 for why that is an owner's decision rather than a quiet edit.
